Your free profile rights stay free

Claiming the basic profile, legitimate basic management, factual corrections and public-profile removal do not require Community Membership.

Recommended next steps

Use the highest-value member tools first.

  1. Add or review your business logo/profile image. Make the profile recognizable while preserving the current review and ownership controls.
  2. Review your business information. Confirm the public profile represents the correct business or organization.
  3. Improve your description, services and hours. Give Franklin residents useful details for evaluating your business.
  4. Add additional approved profile media. Community Members can use reviewed cover and gallery media where eligible.
  5. Add useful customer-action links. Use supported website, contact, booking, quote, reservation, ordering or similar links when appropriate.
  6. Create a coupon, special, sale or promotion. Add clear terms, dates, codes and a supported action link.
  7. Add an upcoming event. Include current dates, location information and useful event details.
  8. Add reviewed promotional media. Upload or replace eligible graphics, flyer images or reviewed PDF flyers/documents.
  9. Preview before you submit. Review the resident-facing content and attached media, then submit it for Franklin review.
  10. Keep time-sensitive information current. Expired offers and past events stop appearing as current.
